## Highlights

- `n8n workflow copy` — copy one saved workflow definition between two saved contexts (e.g. staging to production, or production back to staging for rollback). Source is only ever read; every write lands on target. Match source by `--from-id` or `--name`, target by `--to-id` or name with create-when-absent. Target is fully replaced unless `--create-only` / `--update-only` given; existing target stays draft unless `--publish` passed. Tags, credentials, folders, sharing do not transfer (per-instance IDs). Pinned sample data + runtime static data excluded unless `--include-pinned-data` / `--include-static-data`. Refuses same-instance copy + archived workflows. Text = summary, `--output json` = versioned result. Verify afterwards with `n8n workflow diff`.
